title: Release train orchestration: milestone cadence, cut-sentinels, and cross-team release comms
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Objective: define an operational playbook for the Q2 release train that spans Redwood API, Console, and Runtime so launches are predictable, cross-team handoffs are explicit, and release notes are coordinated across PM/Design/Eng/Marketing. Goals: 1) Agree on milestone cadence and ownership for alpha/beta/general availability (GA) gates; 2) Define explicit 'cut-sentinels' (measurable signals) that trigger scope lock or scope rollback; 3) Establish a single annotated release-notes draft workflow and owners; 4) Create a comm-lane matrix for customer-facing and internal stakeholders; 5) Surface dependencies and a minimal contingency plan for rollbacks and partial launches.

Scope (what this ticket covers): release orchestration mechanics and comms only — not the implementation tasks for features. This covers API, Console, Runtime components and the cross-team coordination artifacts (gated milestones, checklists, release-notes staging, rollout matrix).

Milestone cadence (proposed):
- M0 (T - 8w): Feature complete candidate list finalized; owners committed; initial risk review
- M1 (T - 6w): Integration smoke (API <> Runtime <> Console) + perf baseline; first draft release notes
- M2 (T - 4w): Beta signoff checkpoint; security/compliance review in flight; rollout playbook drafted
- M3 (T - 2w): Scope lock (final feature exclusions accepted); QA regression pass; executive readiness review
- M4 (T - 1w): Docs/release-notes freeze; support runbook and comms rehearsal
- M5 (T + 0): Launch (canary -> ramp -> GA based on rollout matrix)

Cut-sentinels (signals that force scope reduction or rollback of risky items):
- Perf sentinel: 95th percentile latency increase > 30% vs baseline under production-like load
- Reliability sentinel: Error rate (5xx) increase of 0.5 percentage points sustained for 15m on core routes
- Regression sentinel: >3 high-severity failing test groups in the regression suite that block merchant use-cases
- Security sentinel: Any open critical security issue without a compensating control or mitigation plan
- Compliance sentinel: Failure to complete KMS/HSM integration checklist for private deployments

Decision policy: If any sentinel trips and cannot be mitigated within the 48-hour mitigation window, the associated feature(s) must be gated behind a rollout flag and excluded from GA. PM + Eng + SRE are jointly responsible for the mitigation decision; execs are notified for P0 escalations.

Release-notes workflow (single source of truth):
- Draft lives in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/releases/Q2-2026/release-notes-draft.md
- Owners: PM owner curates feature bullets; Design owner supplies screenshots/illustrations; Eng owner provides API/compatibility notes and breaking-change indicators
- Staging: Use the 'release-notes' branch in docs repo (gh: redwood/docs, PR template: Release Notes Draft) for final editorial pass
- Signoff: PM + Design + Eng lead + Legal for claims + Support for triage notes

Cross-team comm-lane matrix (summary):
- External marketing: Messaging + feature highlights (Marketing lead)
- Developer comms: API changelog, migration guide, SDK notes (Docs/SDK owners)
- Enterprise customers: Account team comm bundle + dedicated rollouts (Sales/CS owners)
- Internal ops: Pager/Runbooks updated (SRE/Support owners)

Deliverables by M3: annotated release-notes draft, rollout matrix, contingency rollback plan, checklist for each sentinel, and an owner roster with on-call rotations during launch week.

Acceptance criteria:
- Milestone calendar published and accepted by core leads
- Release-notes draft with stubbed bullets for every planned feature
- Sentinel thresholds configured in telemetry dashboards and smoke tests
- Rollout matrix mapped to canary windows and automated fallback policies

Links and artifacts:
- PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRD/Q2+Release+Train
- Release-notes draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/releases/Q2-2026/release-notes-draft.md
- Docs repo PR template: https://github.com/redwood/docs/blob/main/.github/RELEASE_NOTE_TEMPLATE.md
- Perf dashboard (staging): https://dash.redwood.ai/d/staging/perf-baselines

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Runtime perf regressions from new kernel selection heuristics. Mitigation: Controlled perf A/B in Dedicated environment and early perf benchmark run at M1.
- Risk: Docs/SDK lagging feature readiness. Mitigation: Blocking checklist item requiring docs 'first draft' by M2 for any public API change.
- Risk: Cross-team misalignment around scope. Mitigation: Weekly alignment cadences and an M3 mandatory scope-lock meeting with exec signoff.

Notes on communication cadence: Weekly triage w/ core leads (PM, Eng, Design, SRE, Docs, Support, Marketing) until M3, then twice-weekly until launch. Use the #release-train-Q2 Slack channel for asynchronous updates and a summary bulletin posted on Friday of each week.
